# System Design Diagram Builder

> A 100% client-side, no-backend, no-account web app for building system
> architecture diagrams (600+ predefined components, sequence diagrams, and more).
> Everything runs in the browser — there is no API server to call.

An AI agent or CLI tool that wants to generate a diagram for a user of this app
should read the full integration guide below before producing anything — it defines
the exact JSON format this app understands and the two zero-server ways to hand a
generated diagram to the user (a direct link, or paste/import).

## Docs

- [AI / CLI Integration Guide](docs/AI_INTEGRATION.md): the JSON schema, a direct
  share-link encoding method with runnable code, and paste/import instructions.
- [Functional Specification](docs/SPEC.md): every feature this app supports, in
  detail.
- [User Guide](help.html): the in-app guide, written for a human.
